literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在猫和鼠样本的多种组织中检测到了高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒,且与禽流感分离株具有高度序列同源性。 [10.3201/eid3210.260418]
在中孕期感染导致在胎盘和胎儿组织中检测到感染性H5N1,而在人类第三孕期等效阶段(E16)感染则导致病毒存在于乳腺组织、乳汁和哺乳幼崽中。 [10.1038/s41684-026-01810-w]
提供的证据没有明确说明直接观察到的主要结果。 [10.3201/eid3210.260186]
在此,我们开发了三种基于CRISPR的简化感染监测平台(SHINE)检测方法,以解决这些限制。 [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117556]
研究结果表明,该病毒是一种重组病毒,来源于当地循环的低致病性禽流感病毒与高致病性北美谱系。 [10.3201/eid3210.260723]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses literature
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus was detected in multiple tissues of cat and rat samples, with high sequence identity to an avian isolate. [10.3201/eid3210.260418]

Infection during mid-gestation resulted in the detection of infectious H5N1 in placental and fetal tissues, while infection during the human third trimester equivalent led to viral presence in mammary tissue, milk, and nursing pups. [10.1038/s41684-026-01810-w]
The supplied evidence does not clearly state a directly observed main result. [10.3201/eid3210.260186]
Here, we develop three CRISPR-based Streamlined Highlighting of Infections to Navigate Epidemics (SHINE) assays that address these limitations. [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117556]
The results showed that the virus was a reassortant emerging from locally circulating low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses and highly pathogenic North American lineages. [10.3201/eid3210.260723]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
在猫和鼠样本的多种组织中检测到了高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒,且与禽流感分离株具有高度序列同源性。 [10.3201/eid3210.260418]。
在中孕期感染导致在胎盘和胎儿组织中检测到感染性H5N1,而在人类第三孕期等效阶段(E16)感染则导致病毒存在于乳腺组织、乳汁和哺乳幼崽中。 [10.1038/s41684-026-01810-w]。
提供的证据没有明确说明直接观察到的主要结果。 [10.3201/eid3210.260186]。
在此,我们开发了三种基于CRISPR的简化感染监测平台(SHINE)检测方法,以解决这些限制。 [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117556]。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
The highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus was detected in multiple tissues of cat and rat samples, with high sequence identity to an avian isolate. [10.3201/eid3210.260418].

Infection during mid-gestation resulted in the detection of infectious H5N1 in placental and fetal tissues, while infection during the human third trimester equivalent led to viral presence in mammary tissue, milk, and nursing pups.
The supplied evidence does not clearly state a directly observed main result. [10.3201/eid3210.260186].
Here, we develop three CRISPR-based Streamlined Highlighting of Infections to Navigate Epidemics (SHINE) assays that address these limitations. [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117556].
literature.zh: 本期禽流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。；在猫和鼠样本的多种组织中检测到了高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒,且与禽流感分离株具有高度序列同源性。 [10.3201/eid3210.260418]。；在中孕期感染导致在胎盘和胎儿组织中检测到感染性H5N1,而在人类第三孕期等效阶段(E16)感染则导致病毒存在于乳腺组织、乳汁和哺乳幼崽中。 [10.1038/s41684-026-01810-w]。；提供的证据没有明确说明直接观察到的主要结果。 [10.3201/eid3210.260186]。；在此,我们开发了三种基于CRISPR的简化感染监测平台(SHINE)检测方法,以解决这些限制。 [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117556]。
literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. The highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus was detected in multiple tissues of cat and rat samples, with high sequence identity to an avian isolate. [10.3201/eid3210.260418]. Infection during mid-gestation resulted in the detection of infectious H5N1 in placental and fetal tissues, while infection during the human third trimester equivalent led to viral presence in mammary tissue, milk, and nursing pups. The supplied evidence does not clearly state a directly observed main result. [10.3201/eid3210.260186]. Here, we develop three CRISPR-based Streamlined Highlighting of Infections to Navigate Epidemics (SHINE) assays that address these limitations. [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117556].

news.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 新西兰在一只迁徙海鸟检测呈阳性后发现了首例H5N1禽流感病例,卫生官员随即启动了针对五种濒危物种中300只核心繁殖鸟类的疫苗接种计划。 [news-ece4e0f80fc02578]
H5N1禽流感已重返美国中西部家禽养殖场,多个火鸡养殖场受到影响。此信息由CIDRAP报告。 [news-3b33c244adc6bf0b]
H5N1禽流感暴发在中西部地区的商业家禽养殖场中被报告,包括明尼苏达州、北达科他州和印第安纳州,以及爱荷华州的一个后院养殖场。美国农业部(USDA)动物与植物健康检验局(APHIS)确认了这些暴发。 [news-900630f2c1561c15]
动物福利组织批评了犹他州水貂养殖场对禽流感 暴发 的反应。犹他州农业和食品部 8 月份确认了 7 起圈养水貂 禽流感 病例,但由于隐私问题和缺乏处理此类案件的既定协议,有关 暴发 的细节仍不清楚。 [news-706a99474b960b76]
圭亚那对禽流感(H5N1 禽流感)保持高度警惕,至少在邻国苏里南发生 暴发 后。(苏里南和圭亚那的回复中提到的 暴发 证实了这一点)。 [news-1130bc61f3dd132d]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.headline_en: Recent Avian influenza A viruses news
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Avian influenza A viruses news developments.
key_findings_en: New Zealand detected its first case of H5N1 bird flu after a migratory seabird tested positive, and health officials began a vaccination programme for 300 core breeding birds from five endangered species. [news-ece4e0f80fc02578]
H5N1 avian flu has returned to Midwest poultry farms, with multiple turkey operations affected. This is reported by CIDRAP. [news-3b33c244adc6bf0b]

H5N1 avian flu outbreaks were reported in commercial poultry facilities in the Midwest, including Minnesota, the Dakotas, and Indiana, as well as a backyard operation in Iowa. The US Department of Agriculture (USDA) Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) confirmed these outbreaks. [news-900630f2c1561c15]
Animal welfare groups criticized the response to the bird flu outbreak at a Utah mink farm. [news-706a99474b960b76]

brief_items_zh: 本期禽流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
新西兰在一只迁徙海鸟检测呈阳性后发现了首例H5N1禽流感病例,卫生官员随即启动了针对五种濒危物种中300只核心繁殖鸟类的疫苗接种计划。 [news-ece4e0f80fc02578]。
H5N1禽流感已重返美国中西部家禽养殖场,多个火鸡养殖场受到影响。此信息由CIDRAP报告。 [news-3b33c244adc6bf0b]。
H5N1禽流感暴发在中西部地区的商业家禽养殖场中被报告,包括明尼苏达州、北达科他州和印第安纳州,以及爱荷华州的一个后院养殖场。美国农业部(USDA)动物与植物健康检验局(APHIS)确认了这些暴发。
动物福利组织批评了犹他州水貂养殖场对禽流感 暴发 的反应。犹他州农业和食品部 8 月份确认了 7 起圈养水貂 禽流感 病例,但由于隐私问题和缺乏处理此类案件的既定协议,有关 暴发 的细节仍不清楚。

papers.title: Detection of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) Virus in Cat and Rats during Outbreak in Backyard Poultry, United States, 2025
papers.abstract: In 2025, highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus was detected in a poultry flock in Illinois, USA. Quantitative reverse transcription PCR, sequencing, and histopathology on cat and rat samples from the farm showed multiple positive tissues and high sequence identity to an avian isolate. Small mammals might contribute to H5N1 transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the potential transmission of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus to small mammals during an outbreak in backyard poultry in the United States in 2025.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted during an outbreak in a poultry flock in Illinois, USA, in 2025, and involved the examination of cat and rat samples from the farm.
analysis.methods: Quantitative reverse transcription PCR, sequencing, and histopathology were performed on cat and rat samples to detect and analyze the presence of the highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus.
analysis.main_results: The highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus was detected in multiple tissues of cat and rat samples, with high sequence identity to an avian isolate.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that small mammals might be involved in the transmission of H5N1 virus, highlighting a potential zoonotic pathway.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide important insights into the zoonotic potential of H5N1 virus and its possible role in transmission to small mammals, which could inform surveillance and prevention strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single outbreak and does not provide long-term data, but the evidence is strong due to the direct detection of the virus in multiple tissues of the animals.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the transmission of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus to small mammals during an outbreak in backyard poultry in Illinois, USA, in 2025. The researchers used quantitative reverse transcription PCR, sequencing, and histopathology on cat and rat samples from the farm and found multiple positive tissues with high sequence identity to an avian isolate. These findings suggest that small mammals might contribute to H5N1 transmission, offering insights into the zoonotic potential of the virus. The study provides important information for surveillance and prevention strategies but is limited to a single outbreak and does not include long-term data. The evidence is strong due to the direct detection of the virus in the animals.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒在2025年美国家庭养鸡场暴发期间对小型哺乳动物的潜在传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在2025年美国伊利诺伊州一家禽群的暴发期间进行,涉及对农场中猫和鼠样本的检查。
elements_zh.methods: 对猫和鼠样本进行了定量逆转录PCR、测序和组织病理学分析,以检测和分析高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒的存在。
elements_zh.main_results: 在猫和鼠样本的多种组织中检测到了高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒,且与禽流感分离株具有高度序列同源性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,小型哺乳动物可能参与H5N1病毒的传播,突显了其潜在的人兽共患病传播途径。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为H5N1病毒的人兽共患病潜力及其可能对小型哺乳动物的传播作用提供了重要见解,有助于制定监测和预防策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于一次暴发,未提供长期数据,但由于在动物的多种组织中直接检测到了病毒,证据较为有力。

papers.title: Diminished sialoside binding in novel H5N1 influenza hemagglutinin variants identified in a human patient
papers.abstract: In 2024, an adolescent female in British Columbia was hospitalised presenting with severe symptoms including respiratory failure due to infection with a novel H5N1 influenza strain (BC24). Using cryogenic electron microscopy, we show here that the N169 α2,3-linked auto-glycan that is found in the sialic acid binding site of previously studied H5 hemagglutinin (HA) proteins is absent in purified BC24 HA protein, suggesting greatly reduced affinity for α2,3-linked sialosides. Glycan microarray and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay analyses show that HA variants identified in the BC24 case display severely reduced or no binding to both α2,3-linked sialosides and α2,6-linked sialosides. Full-length BC24 HA expressed in A549 alveolar carcinoma cells drives membrane fusion, albeit at lower levels than previous H5 HA proteins, and post-infection sera from the patient display strong binding to BC24 HA and HA proteins from other influenza subtypes. As each of the two mutations of interest, independently and in conjunction, severely reduce sialoside binding, there appears to have been in this case multiple populations of virus with the diminished receptor binding phenotype. The substantial minority prevalence of weakly binding HA variants in this BC24 case reveals further complexity in the factors that may be present in severe avian influenza infection. This study explores the biochemical and structural roles of hemagglutinin mutations identified in a human case of H5N1 influenza and reports effects of the mutations in patient viral populations on sugar binding and membrane fusion.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the diminished sialoside binding observed in a novel H5N1 influenza strain isolated from a human patient, addressing the knowledge gap regarding the functional implications of such mutations in avian influenza viruses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in 2024 involving an adolescent female in British Columbia who was hospitalised with severe respiratory failure due to infection with a novel H5N1 influenza strain (BC24).
analysis.methods: The researchers used cryogenic electron microscopy, glycan microarray analysis, and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay to examine the structural and functional properties of the HA protein from the BC24 isolate, comparing its binding characteristics to those of previously studied H5 HA proteins.
analysis.main_results: The HA variants from the BC24 case showed severely reduced or no binding to both α2,3-linked and α2,6-linked sialosides, and full-length BC24 HA expressed in A549 cells drove membrane fusion at lower levels than previous H5 HA proteins. Post-infection sera from the patient strongly bound to BC24 HA and HA proteins from other influenza subtypes.

papers.title_zh: 在一名人类患者中鉴定出新型H5N1流感血凝素变体中唾液酸结合能力减弱
papers.source_body_en: In 2024, an adolescent female in British Columbia was hospitalised presenting with severe symptoms including respiratory failure due to infection with a novel H5N1 influenza strain (BC24). Using cryogenic electron microscopy, we show here that the N169 α2,3-linked auto-glycan that is found in the sialic acid binding site of previously studied H5 hemagglutinin (HA) proteins is absent in purified BC24 HA protein, suggesting greatly reduced affinity for α2,3-linked sialosides. Glycan microarray and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay analyses show that HA variants identified in the BC24 case display severely reduced or no binding to both α2,3-linked sialosides and α2,6-linked sialosides. Full-length BC24 HA expressed in A549 alveolar carcinoma cells drives membrane fusion, albeit at lower levels than previous H5 HA proteins, and post-infection sera from the patient display strong binding to BC24 HA and HA proteins from other influenza subtypes. As each of the two mutations of interest, independently and in conjunction, severely reduce sialoside binding, there appears to have been in this case multiple populations of virus with the diminished receptor binding phenotype. The substantial minority prevalence of weakly binding HA variants in this BC24 case reveals further complexity in the factors that may be present in severe avian influenza infection. This study explores the biochemical and structural roles of hemagglutinin mutations identified in a human case of H5N1 influenza and reports effects of the mutations in patient viral populations on sugar binding and membrane fusion.
papers.abstract_zh: 2024年,一名不列颠哥伦比亚省的青少年女性因感染新型H5N1流感毒株(BC24)而住院,表现出严重的症状,包括呼吸衰竭。本文通过冷冻电子显微镜显示,此前研究的H5血凝素(HA)蛋白中在唾液酸结合位点发现的N169 α2,3-连接的自糖基,在纯化的BC24 HA蛋白中缺失,表明其对α2,3-连接唾液酸的亲和力显著降低。糖基微阵列和酶联免疫吸附测定分析显示,BC24病例中鉴定出的HA变体对α2,3-连接唾液酸和α2,6-连接唾液酸的结合能力显著减弱或完全缺失。全长BC24 HA在A549肺泡癌细胞中驱动膜融合,但其水平低于以往H5 HA蛋白。患者感染后的血清对BC24 HA及其他流感亚型的HA蛋白表现出强结合能力。由于两种感兴趣的突变分别独立和共同作用,显著降低唾液酸结合能力,因此在该病例中似乎存在多种具有受体结合能力减弱的病毒群体。该BC24病例中大量弱结合HA变体的存在,进一步揭示了可能导致严重禽流感感染的复杂因素。本研究探讨了在人类H5N1流感病例中鉴定出的血凝素突变的生化和结构作用,并报告了这些突变在患者病毒群体中对糖结合和膜融合的影响。

papers.title: Detection of Divergent Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) Clade 2.3.4.4b Virus, São Paulo, Brazil, 2025
papers.abstract: In 2025, we detected highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus in dead waterfowl at Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo, Brazil. Genomic characterization indicated a reassortant virus that emerged from locally circulating low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses and highly pathogenic North American lineages. Our results highlight cross-species transmission risk and underscore the need for enhanced surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: In 2025, we detected highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus in dead waterfowl at Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo, Brazil. The study aimed to investigate the emergence of a novel virus with potential zoonotic implications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved genomic characterization of a virus detected in dead waterfowl at Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo, Brazil, in 2025. It focused on understanding the origin and genetic makeup of the virus.
analysis.methods: Genomic characterization was used to analyze the virus, indicating its reassortant nature from locally circulating low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses and highly pathogenic North American lineages.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that the virus was a reassortant emerging from locally circulating low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses and highly pathogenic North American lineages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Our results highlight cross-species transmission risk and underscore the need for enhanced surveillance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of monitoring avian influenza viruses for potential zoonotic transmission and guide the development of targeted surveillance strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single outbreak and the absence of broader epidemiological data, but the genomic evidence provides a moderate level of confidence in the interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the detection of a highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus in dead waterfowl at Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo, Brazil, in 2025. Genomic analysis revealed that the virus is a reassortant emerging from locally circulating low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses and highly pathogenic North American lineages. The findings highlight the risk of cross-species transmission and emphasize the need for enhanced surveillance. The study's focus on a single outbreak limits its generalizability, but the genomic evidence supports a moderate confidence in the conclusions. These results have implications for understanding the evolution and spread of avian influenza viruses, particularly in regions where they may interact with other viral lineages. The study contributes to the broader knowledge of avian influenza dynamics and the potential for zoonotic transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025年,我们在巴西圣保罗伊比拉普埃拉公园死水禽中检测到高致病性禽流感 H5N1病毒。本研究旨在探讨一种具有潜在人兽共患病风险的新病毒的出现。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及对2025年在巴西圣保罗伊比拉普埃拉公园死水禽中检测到的病毒进行基因组特征分析,重点在于理解该病毒的起源和基因组成。
elements_zh.methods: 通过基因组特征分析来研究该病毒,表明其来源于当地循环的低致病性禽流感病毒与高致病性北美谱系的重组。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,该病毒是一种重组病毒,来源于当地循环的低致病性禽流感病毒与高致病性北美谱系。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究结果突显了跨物种传播传播的风险,并强调了需要加强监测监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了监测禽流感病毒以评估潜在人兽共患病传播的重要性,并指导了针对性监测策略的制定。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅关注单一暴发样本,且缺乏更广泛的流行病学数据,但基因组证据为解释提供了中等程度的置信度。}}.{

papers.title: Comparison of Baloxavir-Based Combinations and Monotherapies for Treating Influenza A(H5N1) Clade 2.3.4.4b Virus Infection in Mice
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b virus continues to cause animal outbreaks and sporadic zoonotic infections. In a mouse model of lethal influenza disease, we compared oseltamivir, baloxavir, and molnupiravir monotherapies with 2-drug combinations. Baloxavir-based combinations improved survival, reduced lung viral loads, and prevented extrapulmonary dissemination, supporting H5N1 preparedness strategies.

papers.title: N70S/Y155H Combined Mutation of Neuraminidase of Avian Influenza H9N2 Virus confers oseltamivir and zanamivir resistance and pathogenicity to Mice.
papers.abstract: Recently, H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a significant threat to both the poultry industry and public health. Therefore, investigating the impact of its neuraminidase mutations on susceptibility to neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs) is of great importance for clinically preventing potential cross-species transmission of H9N2. In this study, our results revealed that NAI resistance-related mutations of most H9N2 viruses isolated from China during 1998 to 2024 mainly occurred at positions N70S, E119A/D/G/V, Q133K, Q136A, D151E, Y155H, I222V, R224K, E276D, R292K, N294S, and R371K. Among them, the combined N70S and Y155H mutations are common characteristics of H9N2 viruses circulating in recent years. In vivo experiments demonstrated that these H9N2 viruses harboring the combined N70S and Y155H mutations exhibit high pathogenicity to BALB/c mice without prior adaption. In vitro neuraminidase inhibition assays confirmed that these H9N2 viruses bearing the N70S/Y155H mutations exhibited greater reduced inhibition than their counterparts bearing the N70S or Y155H single mutation to oseltamivir and zanamivir, but remained highly sensitive to peramivir. Notably, the in vivo protective effect of NAIs against H9N2 virus with combined N70S and Y155H mutations is limited, possibly due to the restricted ability of these drugs to ameliorate the excessive inflammatory responses. Therefore, there is an urgency to strengthen research on epidemiological surveillance and prevention strategies for avian influenza H9N2 harboring these mutations.

analysis.methods: The study utilized in vitro neuraminidase inhibition assays and in vivo experiments with BALB/c mice to assess the pathogenicity and drug resistance of H9N2 viruses.
analysis.main_results: The combined N70S and Y155H mutations in H9N2 viruses resulted in high pathogenicity in mice and reduced susceptibility to oseltamivir and zanamivir, but not to peramivir.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a limited number of virus isolates and the lack of long-term adaptation experiments, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of N70S and Y155H mutations in H9N2 avian influenza virus on drug resistance and pathogenicity in mice. elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究发现,N70S/Y155H 组合 突变 使 H9N2 病毒对奥司他韦和扎那米韦产生耐药性,并具有致病性,强调了进一步研究 监测 和预防策略的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,携带这些 突变 的 H9N2 病毒对家禽业和公共卫生构成重大威胁,需要加强 监测 和预防措施,以应对潜在的跨物种 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用的病毒分离株数量有限,以及缺乏长期适应实验,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍适用性。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the impact of neuraminidase mutations on the susceptibility of H9N2 avian influenza virus to neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs), addressing the need to understand the threat posed by H9N2 to both the poultry industry and public health.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved in vitro and in vivo experiments with H9N2 viruses isolated from China between 1998 and 2024, focusing on the combined N70S and Y155H mutations in neuraminidase.
analysis_en.methods: The study utilized in vitro neuraminidase inhibition assays and in vivo experiments with BALB/c mice to assess the pathogenicity and drug resistance of H9N2 viruses.
analysis_en.main_results: The combined N70S and Y155H mutations in H9N2 viruses resulted in high pathogenicity in mice and reduced susceptibility to oseltamivir and zanamivir, but not to peramivir.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that the combined N70S and Y155H mutations confer oseltamivir and zanamivir resistance and pathogenicity to mice, highlighting the need for further research on surveillance and prevention strategies.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that H9N2 viruses with these mutations pose a significant threat and require enhanced surveillance and prevention measures to mitigate potential cross-species transmission.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a limited number of virus isolates and the lack of long-term adaptation experiments, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

papers.title_zh: N70S/Y155H 组合的 H9N2 病毒神经氨酸酶 突变 使病毒对奥司他韦和扎那米韦产生耐药性并具有致病性
papers.source_body_en: Recently, H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a significant threat to both the poultry industry and public health. Therefore, investigating the impact of its neuraminidase mutations on susceptibility to neuraminidase inhibitors (NAIs) is of great importance for clinically preventing potential cross-species transmission of H9N2. In this study, our results revealed that NAI resistance-related mutations of most H9N2 viruses isolated from China during 1998 to 2024 mainly occurred at positions N70S, E119A/D/G/V, Q133K, Q136A, D151E, Y155H, I222V, R224K, E276D, R292K, N294S, and R371K. Among them, the combined N70S and Y155H mutations are common characteristics of H9N2 viruses circulating in recent years. In vivo experiments demonstrated that these H9N2 viruses harboring the combined N70S and Y155H mutations exhibit high pathogenicity to BALB/c mice without prior adaption. In vitro neuraminidase inhibition assays confirmed that these H9N2 viruses bearing the N70S/Y155H mutations exhibited greater reduced inhibition than their counterparts bearing the N70S or Y155H single mutation to oseltamivir and zanamivir, but remained highly sensitive to peramivir. Notably, the in vivo protective effect of NAIs against H9N2 virus with combined N70S and Y155H mutations is limited, possibly due to the restricted ability of these drugs to ameliorate the excessive inflammatory responses. Therefore, there is an urgency to strengthen research on epidemiological surveillance and prevention strategies for avian influenza H9N2 harboring these mutations.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来,H9N2 禽流感 病毒(禽流感病毒)对家禽业和公共卫生构成了重大威胁。因此,研究其神经氨酸酶 突变 对神经氨酸酶抑制剂(NAIs)敏感性的影响,对于临床预防 H9N2 的潜在跨物种 传播 具有重要意义。本研究结果表明,1998年至2024年间在中国分离的大多数 H9N2 病毒中,与 NAIs 耐药性相关的神经氨酸酶 突变 主要出现在 N70S、E119A/D/G/V、Q133K、Q136A、D151E、Y155H、I222V、R224K、E276D、R292K、N294S 和 R371K 位点。其中,N70S 和 Y155H 的组合 突变 是近年来 H9N2 病毒的常见特征。体内实验表明,这些携带 N70S/Y155H 组合 突变 的 H9N2 病毒在未经适应的情况下对 BALB/c 小鼠表现出高致病性。体外神经氨酸酶抑制实验确认,这些携带 N70S/Y155H 组合 突变 的 H9N2 病毒对奥司他韦和扎那米韦的抑制作用显著降低,但对拉米夫定仍保持高度敏感。值得注意的是,针对携带 N70S 和 Y155H 组合 突变 的 H9N2 病毒,NAIs 的体内保护效果有限,这可能是因为这些药物无法有效缓解过度的免疫应答。因此,有必要加强针对这些 突变 的 H9N2 病毒的流行病学 监测 和预防策略的研究。

papers.title: Streamlined CRISPR-based assays for detection and subtyping of H5 and H7 avian influenza
papers.abstract: Avian influenza viruses (AIVs) are zoonotic pathogens that pose an increasing global threat due to their potential for significant economic losses in agriculture, and the risk of a pandemic should human-to-human transmission occur. In light of this, we need rapid, sensitive, and specific tests to detect and differentiate circulating AIVs. Current AIV diagnostic methods require specialized laboratory equipment, limiting their use in the field and in low-resource settings. Here, we develop three CRISPR-based Streamlined Highlighting of Infections to Navigate Epidemics (SHINE) assays that address these limitations. We designed, optimized, and validated a SHINE assay for H5 AIV, achieving 100% specificity when tested on seasonal-influenza-positive clinical samples, and a limit of detection of 121.7 copies/μL. We also developed SHINE assays targeting the 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) and Eurasian H7 lineages. Together, these SHINE assays offer a promising platform for AIV diagnosis and surveillance, particularly outside laboratory settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for rapid, sensitive, and specific diagnostic tools for avian influenza viruses (AIVs), which are zoonotic pathogens with significant economic and pandemic risks. The researchers developed three CRISPR-based SHINE assays to detect and subtype AIVs, particularly H5N1 and Eurasian H7 lineages. These assays aim to overcome the limitations of current diagnostic methods that require specialized laboratory equipment, making them suitable for use in field and low-resource settings. The SHINE assays demonstrated high specificity and sensitivity, with a limit of detection of 121.7 copies/μL for H5 AIV. The study highlights the potential of these assays for improving AIV diagnosis and surveillance outside traditional laboratory environments. However, the study does not provide detailed information on limitations or evidence strength, which could affect the confidence in the findings.

papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感病毒(AIVs)是人兽共患病病原体,由于其可能造成农业领域重大经济损失以及人类间传播引发大流行的潜在风险,对全球构成日益增长的威胁。鉴于此,我们需要快速、敏感且特异的检测方法来识别和区分流行的AIVs。目前的AIV诊断方法需要专门的实验室设备,限制了其在野外和资源匮乏地区的应用。在此,我们开发了三种基于CRISPR的简化感染监测与流行病防控(SHINE)检测方法,以解决这些限制。我们设计、优化并验证了针对H5 AIV的SHINE检测方法,在测试季节性流感阳性临床样本时实现了100%的特异性,并达到121.7 copies/μL的检测限。我们还开发了针对2.3.4.4b A(H5N1)和欧亚H7谱系的SHINE检测方法。这些SHINE检测方法为AIV 诊断和监测提供了一个有前景的平台,特别是在非实验室环境中。

papers.title: Detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus, clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype B3.13 in placentas from aborted bovine fetuses
papers.abstract: Infection by highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A(H5N1) virus (family Orthomyxoviridae , taxon species Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae ), clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype B3.13, was first diagnosed in dairy cattle in the United States in March 2024. Here, we present a cluster of bovine abortions in whose placentas HPAI A(H5N1) was detected. Only placentas were submitted in all 5 cases received. Grossly, 3 placentas had multifocal edema; no significant gross abnormalities were observed in the other 2 placentas. Microscopically, one placenta had random areas of mineralization and another placenta had mild neutrophilic placentitis. Reverse-transcription quantitative real-time PCR for influenza A virus and avian influenza A virus subtype H5N1 were positive in all 5 placentas. RNAscope in-situ hybridization for matrix protein gene was positive in one placenta. Routine ancillary tests for bovine abortion diagnostic work-up did not detect any other abortifacient pathogens. We speculate that abortion was caused by the HPAI A(H5N1) virus.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the presence of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus, clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype B3.13, in placentas from aborted bovine fetuses, addressing the scientific and public health problem of zoonotic transmission and the potential impact of avian influenza on cattle.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a cluster of bovine abortions in whose placentas HPAI A(H5N1) was detected. All five cases submitted only placentas for analysis.
analysis.methods: Reverse-transcription quantitative real-time PCR for influenza A virus and avian influenza A virus subtype H5N1 were performed, and RNAscope in-situ hybridization for matrix protein gene was used to confirm the presence of the virus in one placenta.
analysis.main_results: All five placentas tested positive for HPAI A(H5N1) virus using reverse-transcription quantitative real-time PCR. RNAscope in-situ hybridization for matrix protein gene was positive in one placenta. No significant gross abnormalities were observed in two placentas, while three had multifocal edema. Microscopically, one placenta showed random areas of mineralization and another had mild neutrophilic placentitis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence that HPAI A(H5N1) virus may be associated with bovine abortions, highlighting the need for further investigation into its zoonotic potential and impact on cattle.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that HPAI A(H5N1) virus can cause reproductive issues in cattle, which has implications for monitoring zoonotic transmission and managing outbreaks in livestock.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and the absence of additional confirmatory tests. The evidence is moderate as it relies on molecular detection methods and microscopic findings without definitive causal proof.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus, clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype B3.13, in placentas from five aborted bovine fetuses. All placentas tested positive for the virus using reverse-transcription quantitative real-time PCR, with one also showing positive RNAscope in-situ hybridization for the matrix protein gene. Gross abnormalities were observed in three placentas, while microscopic findings included mineralization and mild neutrophilic placentitis. The authors speculate that the virus may be responsible for the abortions, emphasizing the need for further research on its zoonotic impact. The study's small sample size and lack of definitive causal evidence limit its strength, though the findings provide moderate support for the association of HPAI A(H5N1) with bovine reproductive issues.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒(系群2.3.4.4b,基因型B3.13)在流产牛胎儿胎盘中的存在,解决人兽共患病传播的科学和公共卫生问题,并评估禽流感对牛的潜在影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一组在胎盘中检测到HPAI A(H5N1)病毒的牛流产病例。所有5例提交的样本仅用于胎盘分析。
elements_zh.methods: 进行了流感A病毒和禽流感 A型H5N1病毒的逆转录定量实时PCR检测,并通过RNAscope原位杂交检测基质蛋白基因以确认病毒在其中一个胎盘中的存在。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有5个胎盘均通过逆转录定量实时PCR检测出HPAI A(H5N1)病毒。其中一个胎盘通过RNAscope原位杂交检测到基质蛋白基因阳性。两个胎盘未见明显肉眼异常,而三个胎盘则有局灶性水肿。显微镜下观察,一个胎盘显示随机区域的钙化,另一个胎盘则表现出轻度中性粒细胞性胎盘炎。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为这些发现表明HPAI A(H5N1)病毒可能与牛流产有关,强调需要进一步研究其人兽共患病潜力及对牛群的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明HPAI A(H5N1)病毒可能导致牛的繁殖问题,这对监测人兽共患病传播以及管理暴发在畜牧业中的影响具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于样本量较小以及缺乏其他确认性检测。证据强度中等,因为它依赖于分子检测方法和显微镜下的发现,而没有明确的因果证据。

papers.abstract_zh: 在美国,高致病性禽流感(HPAI)A(H5N1)病毒(家族Orthomyxoviridae,种属Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae),亚群2.3.4.4b,基因型B3.13,首次在奶牛中被诊断出,时间为2024年3月。本文报道了一组奶牛流产病例,其胎盘中检测到了HPAI A(H5N1)病毒。所有5例收到的病例仅提交了胎盘。肉眼观察发现,3个胎盘有局灶性水肿;另外2个胎盘未见明显肉眼异常。显微镜下观察,一个胎盘有随机分布的钙化区域,另一个胎盘有轻度中性粒细胞性胎盘炎。所有5个胎盘均通过逆转录定量实时PCR检测到流感A病毒和禽流感病毒亚型H5N1呈阳性。其中一个胎盘通过RNAscope原位杂交检测到基质蛋白基因呈阳性。常规的奶牛流产诊断辅助检测未发现其他致流产病原体。我们推测流产是由HPAI A(H5N1)病毒引起的。
papers.summary_zh: 在美国,高致病性禽流感(HPAI)A(H5N1)病毒(家族Orthomyxoviridae,种属Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae),亚群2.3.4.4b,基因型B3.13,首次在奶牛中被诊断出,时间为2024年3月。本文报道了一组奶牛流产病例,其胎盘中检测到了HPAI A(H5N1)病毒。所有5例收到的病例仅提交了胎盘。肉眼观察发现,3个胎盘有局灶性水肿;另外2个胎盘未见明显肉眼异常。显微镜下观察,一个胎盘有随机分布的钙化区域,另一个胎盘有轻度中性粒细胞性胎盘炎。所有5个胎盘均通过逆转录定量实时PCR检测到流感A病毒和禽流感病毒亚型H5N1呈阳性。其中一个胎盘通过RNAscope原位杂交检测到基质蛋白基因呈阳性。常规的奶牛流产诊断辅助检测未发现其他致流产病原体。我们推测流产是由HPAI A(H5N1)病毒引起的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)病毒(系群2.3.4.4b,基因型B3.13)在流产牛胎儿胎盘中的存在,解决人兽共患病传播的科学和公共卫生问题,并评估禽流感对牛的潜在影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一组在胎盘中检测到HPAI A(H5N1)病毒的牛流产病例。所有5例提交的样本仅用于胎盘分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行了流感A病毒和禽流感 A型H5N1病毒的逆转录定量实时PCR检测,并通过RNAscope原位杂交检测基质蛋白基因以确认病毒在其中一个胎盘中的存在。
analysis_zh.main_results: 所有5个胎盘均通过逆转录定量实时PCR检测出HPAI A(H5N1)病毒。其中一个胎盘通过RNAscope原位杂交检测到基质蛋白基因阳性。两个胎盘未见明显肉眼异常,而三个胎盘则有局灶性水肿。显微镜下观察,一个胎盘显示随机区域的钙化,另一个胎盘则表现出轻度中性粒细胞性胎盘炎。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为这些发现表明HPAI A(H5N1)病毒可能与牛流产有关,强调需要进一步研究其人兽共患病潜力及对牛群的影响。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明HPAI A(H5N1)病毒可能导致牛的繁殖问题,这对监测人兽共患病传播以及管理暴发在畜牧业中的影响具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于样本量较小以及缺乏其他确认性检测。证据强度中等,因为它依赖于分子检测方法和显微镜下的发现,而没有明确的因果证据。

papers.title: Avian influenza overview June-August 2026.
papers.abstract: Between 5 June and 28 August 2026, 110 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A(H5N1) virus detections were reported in domestic (7) and wild (103) birds in 12 countries in Europe. The number of detections remained at a seasonal low throughout the summer, continuing the decline observed since spring. In contrast to previous years, fewer colony-breeding seabirds were affected, and the geographical range of detections was more limited. Further sporadic detections of HPAI A(H5) virus were reported in wild terrestrial carnivores and pinnipeds. Outside Europe, the epidemic continued in the Americas, where also the HPAI A(H7N3) subtype was detected in Mexico. Following its first introduction to mainland Australia, HPAI A(H5N1) virus spread within local wild bird populations and spilled over to terrestrial carnivores and marine mammals. In the US, the number of dairy cattle farms reportedly affected by HPAI A(H5N1) increased, while detections in captive American minks were reported for the first time. Between 5 June and 31 August 2026, 15 cases of avian influenza virus infection were publicly reported in humans (no fatal cases) in three countries and territories: Bangladesh (one A(H5N1) case), Cambodia (one A(H5N1) case) and China (13 A(H9N2) cases). All human cases reported exposure to poultry or a poultry environment prior to detection or onset of illness. Human infections with avian influenza viruses remain rare and no sustained human-to-human transmission has been documented. The risk posed by avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses currently circulating in Europe remains low for the general public in the European Union/European Economic Area (EU/EEA) and low-to-moderate for those occupationally or otherwise exposed to infected animals or contaminated environments.
authors: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
European Union Reference Laboratory for Avian Influenza (EURL)
papers.journal: EFSA journal. European Food Safety Authority

papers.title: Sex differences in vaccine-induced neuraminidase cross-recognition impact H5N1 dissemination to the lower respiratory tract in mice
papers.abstract: H5N1 vaccines have been poorly immunogenic in humans, creating a challenge for vaccine development. Seasonal influenza vaccines offer some cross-protection against H5N1, but there has been no consideration of whether protection differs between the sexes. We investigated sex differences in antibody responses following receipt of either beta-propiolactone inactivated whole virus H1N1 or H5N1 (LAIV backbone) vaccines in C57BL/6 mice. Using systems serology assays, vaccination induced strong homologous and heterologous antibody responses, with females generating greater IgG titers than males against whole virus H1N1 and H5N1, which was primarily mediated by greater IgG responses to neuraminidase (NA) than hemagglutinin (HA) protein. Cross-reactive H5N1 IgG titers were greater among H1N1-vaccinated females, and primarily mediated by greater N1-specific IgG titers. IgG2b and IgG2c were the primary antibody isotypes generated in response to these vaccines, with females having greater IgG2b titers and enhanced binding to FcγRIV for avian and human NA than males following either homologous or heterologous vaccination. Antibody-dependent complement deposition was measured as an FcR-mediated non-neutralizing response against HA and NA and was more robust among H1N1 and H5N1 vaccinated females than their male counterparts in response to homologous HA only. Vaccinated females tended to have greater neutralizing antibody titers than males against the homologous vaccine strain, with limited cross-neutralizing antibodies detected in either sexes. Neuraminidase inhibition titers were greater in vaccinated females than males against the heterologous virus following H1N1 vaccination and against both the vaccine and heterologous viruses following H5N1 vaccination. When H1N1 and H5N1 vaccinated mice were challenged with a lethal dose of A/Texas/37/2024 H5N1, all H5N1 vaccinated mice were protected, regardless of sex. Among H1N1 vaccinated mice, while both sexes were protected against disease, H1N1 vaccinated females restricted virus to the upper respiratory tract and had lower pulmonary virus titers than males at 3 days post challenge. These findings highlight that sex differences in vaccine-induced NA-specific antibody responses are associated with differential respiratory dissemination of H5N1 and that sex should be considered in studies of vaccine-induced cross-reactive influenza immunity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: H5N1 疫苗在人类中免疫原性较差,给疫苗的研发带来了挑战。季节性流感疫苗对H5N1提供了一定的交叉保护,但尚未考虑保护效果是否在性别之间存在差异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们研究了C57BL/6小鼠接种β-丙内酯灭活的全病毒H1N1或H5N1(LAIV骨架)疫苗后抗体反应的性别差异。
elements_zh.methods: 抗体依赖性补体沉积被作为针对HA和NA的FcR介导的非中和反应进行测量,并且在针对同源HA的情况下,接种H1N1和H5N1的雌性小鼠比其雄性对照表现出更强的反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 通过系统血清学检测,疫苗接种诱导了强烈的同源和异源抗体反应,其中雌性小鼠对全病毒H1N1和H5N1产生的IgG滴度高于雄性,这主要由对神经氨酸酶(NA)而非血凝素(HA)蛋白的IgG反应更强所介导。在接种H1N1的雌性小鼠中,交叉反应的H5N1 IgG滴度更高,且主要由针对N1的IgG滴度增加所介导。接种疫苗的雌性小鼠对同源疫苗株的中和抗体滴度高于雄性,但在两种性别中均未检测到显著的交叉中和抗体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,疫苗诱导的针对神经氨酸酶(NA)的抗体反应在性别间的差异与H5N1在呼吸道中的不同扩散有关,并且在研究疫苗诱导的交叉性流感免疫时应考虑性别因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对疫苗的研发以及在研究疫苗诱导的交叉性流感免疫时考虑性别因素具有重要意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括使用单一的小鼠品系以及缺乏直接的临床关联。由于使用了单一的动物模型,证据强度中等,需要进一步的人体研究来验证这些发现。

papers.title_zh: 疫苗诱导的神经氨酸酶交叉识别在小鼠中影响H5N1向下呼吸道传播的性别差异
papers.source_body_en: H5N1 vaccines have been poorly immunogenic in humans, creating a challenge for vaccine development. Seasonal influenza vaccines offer some cross-protection against H5N1, but there has been no consideration of whether protection differs between the sexes. We investigated sex differences in antibody responses following receipt of either beta-propiolactone inactivated whole virus H1N1 or H5N1 (LAIV backbone) vaccines in C57BL/6 mice. Using systems serology assays, vaccination induced strong homologous and heterologous antibody responses, with females generating greater IgG titers than males against whole virus H1N1 and H5N1, which was primarily mediated by greater IgG responses to neuraminidase (NA) than hemagglutinin (HA) protein. Cross-reactive H5N1 IgG titers were greater among H1N1-vaccinated females, and primarily mediated by greater N1-specific IgG titers. IgG2b and IgG2c were the primary antibody isotypes generated in response to these vaccines, with females having greater IgG2b titers and enhanced binding to FcγRIV for avian and human NA than males following either homologous or heterologous vaccination. Antibody-dependent complement deposition was measured as an FcR-mediated non-neutralizing response against HA and NA and was more robust among H1N1 and H5N1 vaccinated females than their male counterparts in response to homologous HA only. Vaccinated females tended to have greater neutralizing antibody titers than males against the homologous vaccine strain, with limited cross-neutralizing antibodies detected in either sexes. Neuraminidase inhibition titers were greater in vaccinated females than males against the heterologous virus following H1N1 vaccination and against both the vaccine and heterologous viruses following H5N1 vaccination. When H1N1 and H5N1 vaccinated mice were challenged with a lethal dose of A/Texas/37/2024 H5N1, all H5N1 vaccinated mice were protected, regardless of sex. Among H1N1 vaccinated mice, while both sexes were protected against disease, H1N1 vaccinated females restricted virus to the upper respiratory tract and had lower pulmonary virus titers than males at 3 days post challenge. These findings highlight that sex differences in vaccine-induced NA-specific antibody responses are associated with differential respiratory dissemination of H5N1 and that sex should be considered in studies of vaccine-induced cross-reactive influenza immunity.
papers.abstract_zh: H5N1 疫苗在人类中免疫原性较差,给疫苗的研发带来了挑战。季节性流感疫苗对H5N1提供了一定的交叉保护,但尚未考虑保护效果是否在性别之间存在差异。我们研究了C57BL/6小鼠接种β-丙内酯灭活的全病毒H1N1或H5N1(LAIV骨架)疫苗后抗体反应的性别差异。通过系统血清学检测,疫苗接种诱导了强烈的同源和异源抗体反应,其中雌性小鼠对全病毒H1N1和H5N1产生的IgG滴度高于雄性,这主要由对神经氨酸酶(NA)而非血凝素(HA)蛋白的IgG反应更强所介导。在接种H1N1的雌性小鼠中,交叉反应的H5N1 IgG滴度更高,且主要由针对N1的IgG滴度增加所介导。针对这些疫苗产生的主要抗体亚型是IgG2b和IgG2c,雌性小鼠的IgG2b滴度高于雄性,并且在接种同源或异源疫苗接种后,对禽类和人类NA的FcγRIV结合能力更强。抗体依赖性补体沉积被作为针对HA和NA的FcR介导的非中和反应进行测量,结果显示在针对同源HA的情况下,接种H1N1和H5N1的雌性小鼠比其雄性对照表现出更强的反应。接种疫苗的雌性小鼠对同源疫苗株的中和抗体滴度高于雄性,但在两种性别中均未检测到显著的交叉中和抗体。在接种H1N1 疫苗接种后,接种疫苗的雌性小鼠对异源病毒的神经氨酸酶抑制滴度高于雄性;在接种H5N1 疫苗接种后,雌性小鼠对疫苗和异源病毒的神经氨酸酶抑制滴度均高于雄性。当用A/Texas/37/2024 H5N1的致死剂量挑战接种H1N1和H5N1的雌雄小鼠时,所有接种H5N1的鼠均受到保护,无论性别如何。在接种H1N1的小鼠中,尽管两种性别均对疾病产生保护,但接种H1N1的雌性小鼠限制了病毒在上呼吸道的扩散,并且在挑战后3天时肺部病毒滴度低于雄性。这些发现表明,疫苗诱导的针对神经氨酸酶(NA)的抗体反应在性别间的差异与H5N1在呼吸道中的不同扩散有关,并且在研究疫苗诱导的交叉性流感免疫时应考虑性别因素。

papers.full_text: According to a new study in mice, highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 can spread from infected mothers to their offspring through multiple routes. Researchers intranasally infected outbred CD-1 pregnant dams with a contemporary bovine H5N1 strain and found that infection timing influenced transmission dynamics. Infection during mid-gestation led to in utero transmission, with infectious virus detected in placental and fetal tissues. Viral proteins were primarily detected in placental trophoblasts, suggesting maternal-fetal spread. When dams were infected during the human third trimester equivalent (E16), the presence of H5N1 was detected in the mammary tissue and the milk of the dams, as well as in the nursing pups, indicating postnatal transmission through lactation. Compared to offspring of mock-infected dams, offspring exposed to maternal infection showed reduced birth size, delayed neurodevelopment and, later in life, deficits in social behavior and working memory accompanied by increased anxiety-like behaviors. The study establishes a useful mouse model for studying the vertical transmission of H5N1 and evaluating interventions aimed at preventing adverse developmental outcomes. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the potential for maternal transmission of H5N1 in mice, addressing the scientific and public health problem of understanding how avian influenza can spread from infected mothers to their offspring through various routes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved intranasal infection of outbred CD-1 pregnant dams with a contemporary bovine H5N1 strain, examining transmission dynamics across different gestational stages and observing outcomes in both placental and fetal tissues.
analysis.methods: Researchers infected pregnant dams with H5N1 during mid-gestation and later during the human third trimester equivalent, then analyzed placental and fetal tissues for viral presence and conducted behavioral assessments on offspring to evaluate developmental impacts.
analysis.main_results: Infection during mid-gestation resulted in the detection of infectious H5N1 in placental and fetal tissues, while infection during the human third trimester equivalent led to viral presence in mammary tissue, milk, and nursing pups.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that H5N1 can transmit vertically from mother to offspring in mice, with distinct transmission patterns depending on the timing of infection, offering novel insights into the mechanisms of maternal-fetal spread.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides critical information for understanding vertical transmission of H5N1, which can inform surveillance strategies, prevention measures, and the development of interventions to mitigate adverse developmental outcomes in offspring.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a mouse model, which may not fully represent human transmission dynamics, and the evidence is based on observational findings without long-term follow-up, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates maternal transmission of H5N1 in mice, revealing that infection during mid-gestation leads to in utero transmission with viral presence in placental and fetal tissues. Infection during the human third trimester equivalent results in postnatal transmission through lactation, with virus detected in mammary tissue, milk, and nursing pups. The research highlights the potential for vertical spread of H5N1 and its impact on offspring development, including reduced birth size, delayed neurodevelopment, and behavioral deficits. These findings contribute to understanding the mechanisms of maternal-fetal transmission and have implications for surveillance and intervention strategies. However, the study is limited to a mouse model, and the evidence is observational, leading to a moderate confidence assessment in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨H5N1在小鼠中通过不同途径从小鼠感染母亲传播给后代的潜力,解决科学和公共卫生问题,即如何理解禽流感如何通过多种途径从小鼠感染母亲传播给其后代。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及将当代牛源H5N1毒株通过鼻腔感染近交系CD-1孕鼠,考察不同孕期阶段的传播动态,并观察胎盘和胎儿组织中的结果。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在小鼠中孕期和人类第三孕期等效阶段(E16)感染孕鼠,随后分析胎盘和胎儿组织中的病毒存在情况,并对后代进行行为评估以评估发育影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在中孕期感染导致在胎盘和胎儿组织中检测到感染性H5N1,而在人类第三孕期等效阶段(E16)感染则导致病毒存在于乳腺组织、乳汁和哺乳幼崽中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,H5N1可以在小鼠中通过母体传播给后代,感染时间不同会导致不同的传播模式,为理解母胎传播机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究为理解H5N1的垂直传播提供了关键信息,有助于制定监测策略、预防措施以及开发干预措施,以减轻后代的不良发育结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于小鼠模型,可能无法完全代表人类传播动态,且证据基于观察性发现,缺乏长期随访,因此结论的信心度中等。

papers.title: PS6-16. HPAI H5N1 Host-cell Interactions and Antiviral Innate Immunity in Bovine Uterine Epithelial Cells.
papers.abstract: Abstract Maintaining livestock productivity is critical for food security, yet production systems are increasingly challenged by environmental and biological factors. Infectious diseases can compromise both animal health and reproductive performance. Uterine epithelial cells line the uterine lumen and form a specialized mucosal immune barrier that balances reproductive processes, including maternal recognition of pregnancy, with protection against pathogens. However, antiviral innate immune responses in bovine uterine epithelial cells remain poorly characterized. This study aimed to establish a novel serum-free bovine uterine epithelial cell culture system that provides a physiologically relevant in vitro model for studying pathogen-epithelial interactions. Using this model, we characterized epithelial innate immune responses to viral stimuli and explored potential mechanisms by which highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 virus may influence reproductive tract immunity. To mimic viral double-stranded RNA, cells were exposed to polyinosinic:polycytidylic acid [poly(I:C)], a synthetic ligand recognized primarily by TLR3. Poly(I:C) exposure resulted in activation of canonical antiviral signaling pathways, including phosphorylation of downstream signaling intermediates associated with TLR3 activation. This response was accompanied by robust induction of interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs), consistent with activation of type I interferon signaling through the interferon alpha/beta receptor (IFNAR). To further characterize interferon responsiveness independently of viral mimic stimulation, epithelial cells were treated with multiple interferon subtypes, including IFN-α, IFN-β, IFN-λ, and IFN-ω. These treatments confirmed that uterine epithelial cells are competent to mount interferon-dependent antiviral responses, although differences in responsiveness among interferon classes were observed. We additionally assessed the potential susceptibility of uterine epithelial cells to HPAI H5N1 virus. Lectin-based immunofluorescence staining demonstrated the presence of cellular glycoprotein receptors associated with HPAI H5N1 viral entry on uterine epithelial cells. Using a lentiviral pseudotyping approach, we further demonstrated that HPAI H5N1 viral envelope proteins and glycoprotein receptors can mediate binding and entry into these cells, suggesting that uterine epithelium could represent a potential target for viral interaction under appropriate physiological conditions. Ongoing work is focused on determining how specific HPAI H5N1 viral proteins modulate innate immune signaling pathways in uterine epithelial cells and whether such interactions influence reproductive pathways mediated by maternal recognition of pregnancy signals. Collectively, these findings establish a tractable epithelial cell model for studying antiviral innate immunity in the reproductive tract and provide a framework for investigating how emerging viral pathogens may influence reproductive health in livestock.

papers.title_zh: PS6-16. 高致病性禽流感 H5N1 宿主细胞相互作用及 抗病毒药物固有免疫在牛子宫上皮细胞中的作用
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Maintaining livestock productivity is critical for food security, yet production systems are increasingly challenged by environmental and biological factors. Infectious diseases can compromise both animal health and reproductive performance. Uterine epithelial cells line the uterine lumen and form a specialized mucosal immune barrier that balances reproductive processes, including maternal recognition of pregnancy, with protection against pathogens. However, antiviral innate immune responses in bovine uterine epithelial cells remain poorly characterized. This study aimed to establish a novel serum-free bovine uterine epithelial cell culture system that provides a physiologically relevant in vitro model for studying pathogen-epithelial interactions. Using this model, we characterized epithelial innate immune responses to viral stimuli and explored potential mechanisms by which highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 virus may influence reproductive tract immunity. To mimic viral double-stranded RNA, cells were exposed to polyinosinic:polycytidylic acid [poly(I:C)], a synthetic ligand recognized primarily by TLR3. Poly(I:C) exposure resulted in activation of canonical antiviral signaling pathways, including phosphorylation of downstream signaling intermediates associated with TLR3 activation. This response was accompanied by robust induction of interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs), consistent with activation of type I interferon signaling through the interferon alpha/beta receptor (IFNAR). To further characterize interferon responsiveness independently of viral mimic stimulation, epithelial cells were treated with multiple interferon subtypes, including IFN-α, IFN-β, IFN-λ, and IFN-ω. These treatments confirmed that uterine epithelial cells are competent to mount interferon-dependent antiviral responses, although differences in responsiveness among interferon classes were observed. We additionally assessed the potential susceptibility of uterine epithelial cells to HPAI H5N1 virus. Lectin-based immunofluorescence staining demonstrated the presence of cellular glycoprotein receptors associated with HPAI H5N1 viral entry on uterine epithelial cells. Using a lentiviral pseudotyping approach, we further demonstrated that HPAI H5N1 viral envelope proteins and glycoprotein receptors can mediate binding and entry into these cells, suggesting that uterine epithelium could represent a potential target for viral interaction under appropriate physiological conditions. Ongoing work is focused on determining how specific HPAI H5N1 viral proteins modulate innate immune signaling pathways in uterine epithelial cells and whether such interactions influence reproductive pathways mediated by maternal recognition of pregnancy signals. Collectively, these findings establish a tractable epithelial cell model for studying antiviral innate immunity in the reproductive tract and provide a framework for investigating how emerging viral pathogens may influence reproductive health in livestock.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 保持畜牧业生产力对于粮食安全至关重要,但生产系统正日益受到环境和生物因素的挑战。传染病不仅会影响动物健康,还可能损害其生殖性能。子宫上皮细胞覆盖子宫腔,并形成一种专门的黏膜免疫屏障,平衡生殖过程,包括母体对妊娠的识别,同时保护机体免受病原体侵害。然而,抗病毒药物固有免疫应答在牛子宫上皮细胞中的作用仍不明确。本研究旨在建立一种新型无血清的牛子宫上皮细胞培养系统,以提供一个生理相关的体外模型,用于研究病原体与上皮细胞的相互作用。利用该模型,我们对上皮细胞固有免疫应答对病毒刺激的反应进行了表征,并探讨了高致病性禽流感(高致病性禽流感)H5N1病毒可能如何影响生殖道免疫的潜在机制。为了模拟病毒双链RNA,细胞被暴露于聚肌苷酸:聚胞苷酸 [poly(I:C)],这是一种主要被TLR3识别的合成配体。poly(I:C)暴露导致了经典抗病毒药物信号通路的激活,包括与TLR3激活相关的下游信号中间体的磷酸化。这种反应伴随着干扰素刺激基因(ISGs)的强烈诱导,这与通过干扰素α/β受体(IFNAR)激活I型干扰素信号一致。为了进一步表征干扰素反应,独立于病毒模拟刺激,上皮细胞被处理多种干扰素亚型,包括IFN-α、IFN-β、IFN-λ和IFN-ω。这些治疗确认了子宫上皮细胞能够启动依赖干扰素的抗病毒药物反应,尽管不同干扰素亚型的反应性存在差异。我们还评估了子宫上皮细胞对高致病性禽流感H5N1病毒的潜在易感性。基于凝集素的免疫荧光染色显示了与高致病性禽流感H5N1病毒进入相关的细胞糖蛋白受体存在于子宫上皮细胞上。通过慢病毒假型化方法,我们进一步证明了高致病性禽流感H5N1病毒包膜蛋白和糖蛋白受体能够介导这些细胞的结合和进入,表明在适当的生理条件下,子宫上皮可能成为病毒相互作用的潜在靶标。正在进行的工作集中在确定特定的高致病性禽流感H5N1病毒蛋白如何调节子宫上皮细胞中的固有免疫信号通路,以及这些相互作用是否会影响由母体妊娠信号介导的生殖途径。总体而言,这些发现建立了一个可操作的上皮细胞模型,用于研究生殖道中的抗病毒药物固有免疫,并为探讨新兴病毒病原体如何影响畜牧业中的生殖健康提供了框架。

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Annually, influenza viruses cause a considerable number of deaths worldwide and are a primary cause of severe respiratory diseases. Finding novel immunogenic locations that might trigger a potent immune response is therefore crucial. Methods The present study utilized bioinformatics techniques to develop mRNA and multiepitope-based vaccines that specifically target the H10N5 Avian Influenza A virus. The epitopes of the hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) proteins on T and B cells of this specific strain were identified using a variety of immunoinformatic techniques. The chosen HTL epitopes and their corresponding major histocompatibility complex (MHC) alleles were docked by using a molecular docking technique. Results A total of 6 linear B cell epitopes, 6 HTL epitopes, and 6 CTL epitopes were chosen for the structural design of preventive vaccines based on mRNA and multiepitope subunit. At physiological pH the developed vaccines demonstrated strong antigenicity, little toxicity, and non-allergenic qualities. The generated multiepitope subunit vaccine for Flu GC content and CAI value, which were determined to be 49.41% and 0.975%, respectively, were assessed using the codon optimization tool. The stable expression of the vaccine in the pET28aþ vector is confirmed by the GC content and CAI value. A significant degree of immune responses was found by in silico immunological simulation. The top ranked docking pose (HDOCK model 3) from ten models was subjected to 100 ns all-atom MD simulation in AMBER22 with the ff19SB force field in explicit OPC water. An average of 6.8 inter-chain hydrogen bonds, in addition to favourable short-range Coulomb (− 1,032 kJ/mol) and Lennard-Jones (− 436 kJ/mol) interaction energies, continued to maintain contact between the interfaces. Using molecular mechanics/Poisson–Boltzmann surface area (MM/PBSA) and molecular mechanics/generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) methods, the calculated free energies are ΔGbind of − 83.30 ± 29.20 and − 94.72 ± 29.41 kcal/mol, respectively, and the residues Lys381, Arg569, Lys396, Glu237, and Glu527 are identified as the leading contributors to the binding free energy. Thus, the constructed vaccine against avian influenza H10N5 A viral strain showed high potential. Conclusion The vaccine candidate demonstrated promising computational characteristics and requires experimental validation. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Background Annually, influenza viruses cause a considerable number of deaths worldwide and are a primary cause of severe respiratory diseases. Finding novel immunogenic locations that might trigger a potent immune response is therefore crucial. Methods The present study utilized bioinformatics techniques to develop mRNA and multiepitope-based vaccines that specifically target the H10N5 Avian Influenza A virus. The epitopes of the hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) proteins on T and B cells of this specific strain were identified using a variety of immunoinformatic techniques. The chosen HTL epitopes and their corresponding major histocompatibility complex (MHC) alleles were docked by using a molecular docking technique. Results A total of 6 linear B cell epitopes, 6 HTL epitopes, and 6 CTL epitopes were chosen for the structural design of preventive vaccines based on mRNA and multiepitope subunit. At physiological pH the developed vaccines demonstrated strong antigenicity, little toxicity, and non-allergenic qualities. The generated multiepitope subunit vaccine for Flu GC content and CAI value, which were determined to be 49.41% and 0.975%, respectively, were assessed using the codon optimization tool. The stable expression of the vaccine in the pET28aþ vector is confirmed by the GC content and CAI value. A significant degree of immune responses was found by in silico immunological simulation. The top ranked docking pose (HDOCK model 3) from ten models was subjected to 100 ns all-atom MD simulation in AMBER22 with the ff19SB force field in explicit OPC water. An average of 6.8 inter-chain hydrogen bonds, in addition to favourable short-range Coulomb (− 1,032 kJ/mol) and Lennard-Jones (− 436 kJ/mol) interaction energies, continued to maintain contact between the interfaces. Using molecular mechanics/Poisson–Boltzmann surface area (MM/PBSA) and molecular mechanics/generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) methods, the calculated free energies are ΔGbind of − 83.30 ± 29.20 and − 94.72 ± 29.41 kcal/mol, respectively, and the residues Lys381, Arg569, Lys396, Glu237, and Glu527 are identified as the leading contributors to the binding free energy. Thus, the constructed vaccine against avian influenza H10N5 A viral strain showed high potential. Conclusion The vaccine candidate demonstrated promising computational characteristics and requires experimental validation. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发针对H10N5 禽流感 A病毒的mRNA和多表位基 疫苗,以应对寻找新型免疫原性位点以引发强效免疫应答并减少流感相关死亡全球负担的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用生物信息学技术从H10N5 禽流感 A病毒的血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)蛋白中鉴定表位,针对T细胞和B细胞,并基于这些表位设计疫苗。
elements_zh.methods: 采用生物信息学技术鉴定并对接表位,利用密码子优化评估疫苗特性,并模拟免疫应答和分子相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 共选择了6个线性B细胞表位、6个HTL表位和6个CTL表位用于疫苗设计。疫苗表现出强抗原性、低毒性以及非致敏特性,具有有前景的计算特性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 构建的疫苗候选疫苗显示出高潜力,需要实验验证,突显了计算方法在禽流感设计中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发针对禽流感的有效疫苗提供信息,可能降低人兽共患病传播和严重呼吸道疾病的风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括需要实验验证以及依赖计算方法,这些方法可能无法完全反映疫苗效力的所有方面。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发针对H10N5 禽流感 A病毒的mRNA和多表位基 疫苗,以应对寻找新型免疫原性位点以引发强效免疫应答并减少流感相关死亡全球负担的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用生物信息学技术从H10N5 禽流感 A病毒的血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)蛋白中鉴定表位,针对T细胞和B细胞,并基于这些表位设计疫苗。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用生物信息学技术鉴定并对接表位,利用密码子优化评估疫苗特性,并模拟免疫应答和分子相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 共选择了6个线性B细胞表位、6个HTL表位和6个CTL表位用于疫苗设计。疫苗表现出强抗原性、低毒性以及非致敏特性,具有有前景的计算特性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 构建的疫苗候选疫苗显示出高潜力,需要实验验证,突显了计算方法在禽流感设计中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发针对禽流感的有效疫苗提供信息,可能降低人兽共患病传播和严重呼吸道疾病的风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括需要实验验证以及依赖计算方法,这些方法可能无法完全反映疫苗效力的所有方面。

papers.title: An interface-engineered signal-on electrochemical aptasensor for H5N2 avian influenza virus detection.
papers.abstract: Outbreaks of avian influenza virus (AIV) cause substantial economic losses in the poultry industry, highlighting the need for sensitive, reliable and field-adaptable detection platforms. In this study, we report a signal-on electrochemical aptasensor for avian influenza virus H5N2(K08-404) by translating a previously reported J3/JH4 cognate aptamer pair into an electrode-confined sandwich sensing format. The simultaneous binding capability of this aptamer pair enabled target-mediated recruitment of the HRP-labeled reporter aptamer and generated a signal-on amperometric response. This signal-on aptasensor was successfully fabricated by immobilizing the primary aptamer on the screen-printed gold electrode followed by the addition of a mixture of the target virus and the secondary aptamer labeled with horseradish peroxidase, thereby generating amplified signal-on electrochemical responses. The fabrication of the sandwich-type aptasensor was characterized by cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. Decreased peak currents and increased peak-to-peak separation supported the stepwise assembly of the electrochemical sensing interface. Analytical performance was evaluated at various virus concentrations using chronoamperometry, revealing a concentration-dependent increase in current response. The aptasensor achieved LODs of 2.00 × 10 4 EID 50 per mL in a buffer and 2.76 × 10 4 EID 50 per mL in a processed duck fecal matrix, with linear working ranges of 3.91 × 10 4 -4.17 × 10 5 EID 50 per mL and 1.95 × 10 4 -1.25 × 10 6 EID 50 per mL, respectively. These results support the feasibility of converting a previously validated H5N2 aptamer pair into a quantitative electrochemical platform for surveillance-oriented virus detection.

In this study, we report a signal-on electrochemical aptasensor for avian influenza virus H5N2(K08-404) by translating a previously reported J3/JH4 cognate aptamer pair into an electrode-confined sandwich sensing format. The simultaneous binding capability of this aptamer pair enabled target-mediated recruitment of the HRP-labeled reporter aptamer and generated a signal-on amperometric response. This signal-on aptasensor was successfully fabricated by immobilizing the primary aptamer on the screen-printed gold electrode followed by the addition of a mixture of the target virus and the secondary aptamer labeled with horseradish peroxidase, thereby generating amplified signal-on electrochemical responses. The fabrication of the sandwich-type aptasensor was characterized by cyclic voltammetry and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. Decreased peak currents and increased peak-to-peak separation supported the stepwise assembly of the electrochemical sensing interface. Analytical performance was evaluated at various virus concentrations using chronoamperometry, revealing a concentration-dependent increase in current response. The aptasensor achieved LODs of 2.00 × 10 4 EID 50 per mL in a buffer and 2.76 × 10 4 EID 50 per mL in a processed duck fecal matrix, with linear working ranges of 3.91 × 10 4 -4.17 × 10 5 EID 50 per mL and 1.95 × 10 4 -1.25 × 10 6 EID 50 per mL, respectively. These results support the feasibility of converting a previously validated H5N2 aptamer pair into a quantitative electrochemical platform for surveillance-oriented virus detection.

papers.abstract_zh: 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 的 暴发 给家禽业造成巨大的经济损失,凸显了对灵敏、可靠和现场适应性检测平台的需求。在这项研究中,我们通过将先前报道的 J3/JH4 同源适体对转化为电极限制的夹心传感格式,报告了一种针对 禽流感 病毒 H5N2(K08-404)的信号电化学适体传感器。该适体对的同时结合能力使得 HRP 标记的报告适体能够以靶标介导的方式募集,并产生信号安培响应。通过将初级适体固定在丝网印刷的金电极上,然后添加目标病毒和辣根过氧化物酶标记的次级适体的混合物,成功地制造了这种信号适体传感器,从而产生放大的信号适体电化学反应。通过循环伏安法和电化学阻抗谱对夹心型适体传感器的制备进行了表征。峰值电流的降低和峰峰分离的增加支持电化学传感接口的逐步组装。使用计时电流分析法评估不同病毒浓度下的分析性能,揭示了电流响应的浓度依赖性增加。该适体传感器在缓冲液中实现了每毫升 2.00 × 10 4 EID 50 的 LOD,在处理过的鸭粪便基质中实现了每毫升 2.76 × 10 4 EID 50 的 LOD,线性工作范围为每毫升 3.91 × 10 4 -4.17 × 10 5 EID 50 和每毫升 1.95 × 10 4 -1.25 × 10 6 EID分别为每毫升 50 个。这些结果支持将先前验证的 H5N2 适体对转化为用于 监测 病毒检测的定量电化学平台的可行性。

papers.title: Evolutionary Trajectories and Multi-lineage Circulation of H5N1 Virus in Multiple Host Interfaces from India: Insights from the Hemagglutinin Gene
papers.abstract: Background: H5N1 influenza virus circulates across multiple avian and mammalian hosts, creating genetically diverse lineages at wildlife-livestock interfaces. Aims: This study assessed hemagglutinin (HA) gene diversity and evolutionary relationships among H5N1 viruses detected in non-human animal hosts in India. Methodology: A total of 140 H5N1 HA gene sequences sampled between 2006 and 2025 were retrieved from the NCBI Virus database. Sequences of at least 1,700 bp were aligned, 111 haplotypes were identified, and a median-joining network was constructed to examine genetic affinities and host-associated connections. Results: The network revealed interconnected lineages with marked host-associated structure. Poultry-associated Gallus gallus haplotypes formed the largest and most complex component, including multiple star-like patterns consistent with substantial diversification. Turkey haplotypes were closely connected to poultry haplotypes, whereas corvid haplotypes formed an extended branch. Haplotypes associated with Felis catus, Panthera tigris, and Panthera pardus were positioned near the periphery of poultry-associated lineages, indicating repeated spillover into mammalian hosts rather than a broad mammalian transmission lineage. Median vectors connected several host-associated branches and represented potential unsampled or intermediate variants. Conclusion: The HA network showed considerable genetic diversity and complex host relationships across poultry, wild birds, and mammals. These findings support integrated genomic surveillance across wildlife-livestock interfaces to improve tracking of lineage emergence and cross-species transmission.
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology

papers.title_zh: 印度多个宿主界面H5N1病毒的进化轨迹和多谱系循环:来自血凝素基因的见解
papers.source_body_en: Background: H5N1 influenza virus circulates across multiple avian and mammalian hosts, creating genetically diverse lineages at wildlife-livestock interfaces. Aims: This study assessed hemagglutinin (HA) gene diversity and evolutionary relationships among H5N1 viruses detected in non-human animal hosts in India. Methodology: A total of 140 H5N1 HA gene sequences sampled between 2006 and 2025 were retrieved from the NCBI Virus database. Sequences of at least 1,700 bp were aligned, 111 haplotypes were identified, and a median-joining network was constructed to examine genetic affinities and host-associated connections. Results: The network revealed interconnected lineages with marked host-associated structure. Poultry-associated Gallus gallus haplotypes formed the largest and most complex component, including multiple star-like patterns consistent with substantial diversification. Turkey haplotypes were closely connected to poultry haplotypes, whereas corvid haplotypes formed an extended branch. Haplotypes associated with Felis catus, Panthera tigris, and Panthera pardus were positioned near the periphery of poultry-associated lineages, indicating repeated spillover into mammalian hosts rather than a broad mammalian transmission lineage. Median vectors connected several host-associated branches and represented potential unsampled or intermediate variants. Conclusion: The HA network showed considerable genetic diversity and complex host relationships across poultry, wild birds, and mammals. These findings support integrated genomic surveillance across wildlife-livestock interfaces to improve tracking of lineage emergence and cross-species transmission.

papers.title: Advances and challenges in avian influenza vaccines: From conventional approaches to next-generation strategies
papers.abstract: Background Avian influenza viruses (AIVs), particularly highly pathogenic H5 and H7 viruses, pose major threats to poultry production, food security, international trade, and public health. Vaccination is an important component of AIV control; however, antigenic evolution, incomplete reduction of viral shedding, and challenges associated with large-scale poultry vaccination limit its effectiveness. In addition to conventional vaccines, recombinant and nucleic-acid platforms have emerged in response to rapidly evolving AIVs. Methods Relevant literature on inactivated, live attenuated, recombinant subunit, viral-vector, DNA, mRNA, and virus-like particle vaccines was evaluated. Immune responses, protection, antigenic breadth, viral shedding, delivery, manufacturing, field applicability, and regulatory considerations were analyzed. Results Inactivated vaccines are well-established, safe, scalable, and cost-effective but provide limited cellular and mucosal immunity and require antigenic matching. Live attenuated vaccines can induce broader immunity and facilitate mass vaccination but present biosafety, reassortment, and genetic-stability concerns. Next-generation platforms provide greater antigenic flexibility and opportunities for broader protection. Viral-vector vaccines can induce both humoral and cellular immunity, while recombinant subunit, DNA, mRNA, and VLP vaccines offer rapid redesign and multivalent formulations. However, challenges remain regarding delivery, stability, manufacturing, durability, and field validation. Conclusions No single platform currently meets all requirements for sustainable AIV control. Future strategies should emphasize conserved or mosaic antigens, durable and mucosal immunity, rapid vaccine updating, DIVA compatibility, and scalable delivery. Combining conventional and emerging platforms through prime-boost or multi-platform strategies may provide more flexible and effective control.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the current state and future directions of avian influenza vaccines, highlighting the limitations of conventional approaches and the potential of next-generation strategies. The research underscores the need for vaccines that can provide broader protection, durable immunity, and scalable delivery. It identifies key challenges in vaccine development, including antigenic evolution, viral shedding, and manufacturing constraints. The study suggests that combining traditional and emerging platforms through prime-boost or multi-platform strategies may enhance vaccine effectiveness. While inactivated vaccines are well-established and cost-effective, they lack sufficient cellular and mucosal immunity. Live attenuated vaccines offer broader immunity but raise biosafety concerns. The paper concludes that no single platform currently meets all requirements for sustainable AIV control, emphasizing the importance of developing vaccines with conserved or mosaic antigens and improved field applicability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感病毒(AIVs),特别是高致病性H5和H7病毒,对家禽生产、粮食安全、国际贸易和公共卫生构成重大威胁。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 疫苗接种是AIV控制的重要组成部分;然而,抗原性进化、病毒 shedding 减少不完全以及大规模家禽疫苗接种相关的挑战限制了其有效性。
elements_zh.methods: 评估了有关灭活、减毒活、重组亚单位、病毒媒介、DNA、mRNA和病毒样颗粒疫苗的相关文献。
elements_zh.main_results: 灭活疫苗已建立、安全、可扩展且成本效益高,但其诱导的细胞和黏膜免疫有限,且需要抗原匹配。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 下一代平台提供了更大的抗原灵活性和更广泛的保护机会。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 未来策略应强调保守或拼接抗原、持久且黏膜免疫、快速疫苗更新、DIVA兼容性以及可扩展的递送方式。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 关于递送、稳定性、制造、持续性和现场验证仍存在挑战。

papers.title_zh: 从传统方法到下一代策略:禽流感 疫苗的发展与挑战
papers.source_body_en: Background Avian influenza viruses (AIVs), particularly highly pathogenic H5 and H7 viruses, pose major threats to poultry production, food security, international trade, and public health. Vaccination is an important component of AIV control; however, antigenic evolution, incomplete reduction of viral shedding, and challenges associated with large-scale poultry vaccination limit its effectiveness. In addition to conventional vaccines, recombinant and nucleic-acid platforms have emerged in response to rapidly evolving AIVs. Methods Relevant literature on inactivated, live attenuated, recombinant subunit, viral-vector, DNA, mRNA, and virus-like particle vaccines was evaluated. Immune responses, protection, antigenic breadth, viral shedding, delivery, manufacturing, field applicability, and regulatory considerations were analyzed. Results Inactivated vaccines are well-established, safe, scalable, and cost-effective but provide limited cellular and mucosal immunity and require antigenic matching. Live attenuated vaccines can induce broader immunity and facilitate mass vaccination but present biosafety, reassortment, and genetic-stability concerns. Next-generation platforms provide greater antigenic flexibility and opportunities for broader protection. Viral-vector vaccines can induce both humoral and cellular immunity, while recombinant subunit, DNA, mRNA, and VLP vaccines offer rapid redesign and multivalent formulations. However, challenges remain regarding delivery, stability, manufacturing, durability, and field validation. Conclusions No single platform currently meets all requirements for sustainable AIV control. Future strategies should emphasize conserved or mosaic antigens, durable and mucosal immunity, rapid vaccine updating, DIVA compatibility, and scalable delivery. Combining conventional and emerging platforms through prime-boost or multi-platform strategies may provide more flexible and effective control.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 禽流感病毒(AIVs),特别是高致病性H5和H7病毒,对家禽生产、粮食安全、国际贸易和公共卫生构成重大威胁。疫苗接种是AIV控制的重要组成部分;然而,抗原性进化、病毒 shedding 减少不完全以及大规模家禽疫苗接种相关的挑战限制了其有效性。除了传统疫苗,重组和核酸平台已出现以应对快速进化的AIVs。方法 评估了有关灭活、减毒活、重组亚单位、病毒媒介、DNA、mRNA和病毒样颗粒疫苗的相关文献。分析了免疫应答、保护效果、抗原广度、病毒 shedding、递送方式、制造、现场应用和监管考虑。结果 灭活疫苗已建立、安全、可扩展且成本效益高,但其诱导的细胞和黏膜免疫有限,且需要抗原匹配。减毒活疫苗可诱导更广泛的免疫应答,并有助于大规模疫苗接种,但存在生物安全、基因重组和遗传稳定性方面的担忧。下一代平台提供了更大的抗原灵活性和更广泛的保护机会。病毒媒介 疫苗可同时诱导体液和细胞免疫,而重组亚单位、DNA、mRNA和VLP 疫苗则提供了快速重新设计和多价制剂的可能性。然而,关于递送、稳定性、制造、持续性和现场验证仍存在挑战。结论 目前没有一种平台能够满足可持续AIV控制的所有要求。未来策略应强调保守或拼接抗原、持久且黏膜免疫、快速疫苗更新、DIVA兼容性以及可扩展的递送方式。通过加强接种或多种平台策略结合传统和新兴平台,可能提供更灵活和有效的控制手段。

papers.full_text: Abstract Influenza has shaped human history for millennia, with avian influenza recently posing challenges due to its potential for cross-species transmission and the risk of triggering pandemics that could hurt both human populations and livestock industries. Avian influenza, the focus of this work, is known to primarily affect birds, both domestic and wild, causing outbreaks worldwide. Furthermore, reports of cross-species transmission of avian flu viruses from livestock to humans are becoming increasingly common, which, while not an immediate issue, could become problematic were one of these viruses to become dangerous to humans. This work introduces AviFluHunt, a tool specifically developed to help with the analysis of bulk data on avian influenza samples, to enable more effective genomic surveillance and timely responses to the virus’s evolution. A set of queries of interest was created to help answer questions of significance for virologists. We focus on tracking genetic markers, understanding viral mutations, and examining essential metadata, including host species, geographical regions, and temporal trends. AviFluHunt processes large datasets of genomic sequences with metadata through a bioinformatic pipeline and presents results in a custom web application, designed to make them accessible and interpretable for researchers. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Influenza has shaped human history for millennia, with avian influenza recently posing challenges due to its potential for cross-species transmission and the risk of triggering pandemics that could hurt both human populations and livestock industries. Avian influenza, the focus of this work, is known to primarily affect birds, both domestic and wild, causing outbreaks worldwide. Furthermore, reports of cross-species transmission of avian flu viruses from livestock to humans are becoming increasingly common, which, while not an immediate issue, could become problematic were one of these viruses to become dangerous to humans. This work introduces AviFluHunt, a tool specifically developed to help with the analysis of bulk data on avian influenza samples, to enable more effective genomic surveillance and timely responses to the virus’s evolution. A set of queries of interest was created to help answer questions of significance for virologists. We focus on tracking genetic markers, understanding viral mutations, and examining essential metadata, including host species, geographical regions, and temporal trends. AviFluHunt processes large datasets of genomic sequences with metadata through a bioinformatic pipeline and presents results in a custom web application, designed to make them accessible and interpretable for researchers. AviFluHunt stands as a lightweight Web application that provides accurate data insights and identifies trends/interesting behaviors associated with avian flu viruses, offering researchers and virologists a new asset for their studies, thereby enhancing their understanding of the virus.
